messages:
Nina (CSM): Noticing a sharp drop for Skyhook Labs: ~58% MoM in API traffic and active seats down 9->3. Renewal in ~40 days. Procurement mentioned Orion in their notes. Need quick triage.
Dev (AM): Can you pull top endpoints and any error spikes?
Nina (CSM): Quick stats:
```
last_30d_calls: 18k
prev_30d_calls: 43k
active_seats: 9 -> 3
top_endpoints: /classify, /batch-embed
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): No infra incidents on our side. Could be cost delta or billing surprise.
Luca (GTM): Orion doing a pilot per procurement. We should offer a two-week reserved pilot + a side-by-side perf & TCO note.
AlertBot: alert: usage-drop detected for account skyhook.labs. Auto-ticket CS-12001 created.
Nina (CSM): Plan: I'll reach out to Elena (procurement) and propose pilot. Priya, can you run a perf/cost quick compare on the two routes?
Priya (Solutions Eng): On it, will post numbers within 2 hours.
Dev (AM): If procurement asks for discount, route to enterprise sales after the call.
Nina (CSM): Outreach draft: "Hi Elena  we noticed usage dip. Can we run a short pilot + share a token-level cost comparison? 30m this week?"
Luca (GTM): Tweak: include suggested times and mention Priya will join for tech validation.
Nina (CSM): Sent. Elena replied "Thu 11am". Invite sent with Priya & Luca.
Dev (AM): Recap: outreach - Nina (done); perf compare - Priya (in progress); pilot terms - Luca (drafted). Check back after Thu call. :thumbsup:
